text: dsh-tldraw-canvas 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话画板插件。它在右侧栏注册 Tldraw 画板，并通过主机接口将每个会话的画布保存在该会话项目目录中，切换会话后仍可继续使用。画板支持绘制与文字标注，客户端会自动保存并显示保存状态。主机端还提供 tldrawCanvas 读取服务及 tldraw_read_canvas 工具，可返回画布形状摘要和可选 PNG 预览，并支持读取旧版快照。适合希望在 DSH 会话中记录草图、流程或说明，并让代理查看画布内容的用户。源码没有配置 API 密钥或外部账号要求。

dsh-tldraw-canvas adds a Tldraw canvas to each DSH session's right sidebar. It autosaves drawings to the session project directory. The tldraw_read_canvas tool returns a shape summary and optional PNG preview for agents. No API key is declared.
想在 DSH 会话的侧边栏里画草图并自动保存。
让代理读取我在画板上画的内容并生成预览。
I want a separate whiteboard for each DSH session that saves automatically.
dsh-tldraw-canvas 的功能「会话侧栏画板」：在 DSH 右侧栏注册 Tldraw 画板标签和引导卡片。用户打开会话画板后可绘图和标注，客户端通过主机接口自动读写该会话的画布。
dsh-tldraw-canvas 的功能「代理读取画布」：主机注册 tldraw_read_canvas 工具，默认读取当前会话，也可指定 session_id；工具返回画布形状与范围摘要，并可附带 PNG 预览。

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · dsh-tldraw-canvas：**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

[](https://github.com/amumulam/dsh-tldraw-canvas/actions/workflows/test.yml)

A **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** plugin that gives every Session its own tldraw canvas in the right sidebar. This build uses the original **MIT-licensed tldraw v1** (2021–2022) instead of the commercially licensed tldraw 5 SDK, so there is no license key, no watermark, and no production gate.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · dsh-tldraw-canvas：The canvas autosaves into the Session's **project directory** — the directory the Workspace groups the Session under — so it travels with the workspace instead of living in browser storage.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/amumulam/dsh-tldraw-canvas.git
```

Install the checked-out directory as a DSH bundle (Plugin Manager → install from
folder, or `install_bundle` with its absolute path). `client.js` is prebuilt, so
the installed copy does not need `node_modules`.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Use：1. Open the right sidebar for a Session.
2. Add a tab from the guide and choose **Tldraw Canvas** / **Tldraw 画板**.
3. Draw. Changes save automatically after a short pause, and again when the tab closes.

The status bar shows the save state and the workspace-relative file path.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Reading a canvas (Agent tool)：The Host half now owns the read path instead of leaving it to ad-hoc filesystem
scripts. It registers the `tldrawCanvas` service and exposes it to agents as:

```text
tldraw_read_canvas
```

Arguments:

- `session_id` — optional; defaults to the calling Session
- `include_preview` — default `true`; renders a PNG preview

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Reading a canvas (Agent tool)：The tool returns a normalized summary (format, shape/stroke/text counts, point
count, bounds, per-shape details) plus the preview image, so an agent can answer
“what is on my canvas?” without reading the JSON file manually. It accepts both
the new v1 documents and legacy v5 snapshots.

Other Host plugins can inject `tldrawCanvas` and call:

```js
const analysis = await ctx.tldrawCanvas.inspect(sessionId);
const { analysis, png } = await ctx.tldrawCanvas.render(sessionId);
```

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Reading a canvas (Agent tool)：`inspect` and `render` are read-only; `configure`/write access stays with the
canvas tab and its autosave.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Workspace vs Session cwd：DSH's **Workspace** is a registry entry: a named directory plus the Sessions
grouped under the directory they were created in. It is not an artifact bucket,
and removing a Workspace never deletes its folder, files, or Session history.

A Session has two directory notions:

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Workspace vs Session cwd：- **Project origin** — immutable `SessionHeader.cwd`. Workspace grouping and
  archived-Session reads are keyed from this path.
- **Effective working directory** — may move later through the
  `working_directory` tool. Agent tools write there, while existing shells keep
  their own process-local directories.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Workspace vs Session cwd：The canvas is anchored to the **project origin**, not the transient effective
cwd. That way a `cd` inside one Session cannot split its drawings across
directories, and a live Session and its archived replay read the same file. Use
a separate Session in another directory for a separate canvas.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Where it saves：```text
<session project directory>/.dsh/tldraw/<session-id>.json
```

The Host resolves the Session's project directory itself, so the browser cannot
choose an arbitrary path. Each canvas is written atomically and survives app
restarts and Session switching.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Legacy v5 drawings：The first release of this plugin used tldraw 5. On the first v1 save of an old file, the Host copies the original next to it:

```text
.dsh/tldraw/<session-id>.v5.json
```

The client detects a v5 snapshot, converts freehand `draw` shapes to v1 points, and shows a **已迁移旧画板 / Legacy canvas migrated** badge. Other v5 shape types are not converted; the badge tooltip reports how many were skipped. The `.v5.json` backup is never deleted by the plugin.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Implementation：- `index.js` — Host half: registers `GET`/`PUT /api/tldraw`, resolves the Session's cwd, reads/writes atomically, and backs up legacy v5 files.
- `src/client-entry.js` — Client half: registers the tldraw tab type, guide card, theme-aware editor, and debounced autosave.
- `src/migrate.js` — v5 draw-segment decoding and v5 → v1 document conversion.
- `src/canvas-model.js` — format-neutral analysis and the dependency-free PNG preview renderer.
- `client.js` — generated bundle.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Similar DSH plugins：There are several community drawing/canvas plugins; the closest ones differ in
editor, storage, and agent surface:

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Similar DSH plugins：| Project | Editor | Where it lives | Persistence | Agent tools |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [johappel/dsh-tldraw](https://github.com/johappel/dsh-tldraw) (package `dsh-whiteboard`) | tldraw 5 | right sidebar tab | workspace-level snapshot store | 9 whiteboard tools |
| [zhang-guo-wen/dsh-whiteboard](https://github.com/zhang-guo-wen/dsh-whiteboard) | draw.io | main gallery + sidebar editor | plugin `files/` directory | editor-oriented |
| [Jegozhou/dsh-excalidraw](https://github.com/Jegozhou/dsh-excalidraw) | Excalidraw 0.18 | main panel | `DSH_HOME/excalidraw/drawings` | 5 typed scene tools |
| [CSlawyer1985/dsh-excalidraw-board](https://github.com/CSlawyer1985/dsh-excalidraw-board) | excalidraw.com iframe | floating overlay | upstream site | none local |
| [lb-aigc/dsh-canvas](https://github.com/lb-aigc/dsh-canvas) | React Flow node canvas | right sidebar + conversation | session projection | 5 node tools |

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Similar DSH plugins：`dsh-tldraw-canvas` is intentionally different: it uses the **MIT tldraw v1**
editor, stores **one file per Session inside that Session's project directory**, and exposes a
**read-only summary + PNG preview** tool rather than a collaborative editing
toolset.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Why tldraw v1：The current tldraw 5 SDK is source-available but requires a commercial/trial/hobby license key in production. The original tldraw v1 is MIT, but it is no longer maintained (last release 1.29.2, 2022). This plugin intentionally trades modern features and maintenance for a genuinely open-source editor.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm run build
```

`npm run build` regenerates `client.js` from `src/client-entry.js`.

dsh-tldraw-canvas README · Tests：```bash
node --test test/*.test.mjs
```

The tests cover the Host API's read/write contract, invalid and concurrent requests, malformed files, temporary-file cleanup, legacy v5 backup, v5 paint-point decoding, v5 → v1 conversion, the reusable read service, and the agent tool's summary/image envelope.
